scope: Public real-time or near-real-time Mobile Bay environmental observations, with emphasis on dissolved oxygen and deployment geometry relevant to Jubilee research.
conclusion: ARCOS is the primary public continuous Mobile Bay hydrographic/meteorological network; Weeks Bay NERRS remains a separate regional water-quality source. The ongoing collector now ingests every hydrographic and meteorological measure exposed by the public ARCOS station dashboard, not just DO.

primary_sources.access: Public Grafana PostgreSQL datasource via g.disl.edu; no credentials required
primary_sources.cadence: Dashboard aggregates/display uses 30-minute intervals; ARCOS map suppresses stations older than 30 minutes
primary_sources.qc: DISL publishes physical range criteria and aggregate flag definitions; current public Grafana frames do not expose aggregate QC flag per returned row, so collector applies range/freshness screens and retains SOURCE_QC_NOT_EXPOSED

stations.name: Dauphin Island
stations.model_role: bay-mouth context; stale values must be UNKNOWN current

stations.name: Bon Secour
stations.model_role: P1 southeast-bay oxygen-loading context when hydro resumes

stations.name: Gulf State Park Pier
stations.model_role: coastal context if hydro becomes available

geometry_research.governing_rule: Historical geometry is useful research evidence but does not prove 2026 deployment continuity. Current bottom/contact-strip identity remains unverified unless current station metadata confirms it.

evidence.source: Liu et al. 2022, Frontiers in Marine Science, DOI 10.3389/fmars.2022.989017
evidence.evidence: The paper compares ARCOS DO observations at MP, BS and DI at 0.5 m above bottom and describes model validation at that elevation.

evidence.source: La Peyre et al. oyster hypoxia study (public copy surfaced via ResearchGate)
evidence.evidence: Methods describe the permanent DISL monitoring sonde as approximately 0.5 m above bottom and collecting at 30-minute intervals.

evidence.source: Gadeken & Dorgan, Sediment macrofaunal response to the diel oxygen cycle
evidence.evidence: Paper states Katrina Cut ARCOS dissolved-oxygen measurements were taken approximately 0.5 m off bottom.
Middle Bay site documented at approximately 4 m total depth with bottom-adjacent monitoring context; current ARCOS instrumentation has been removed during lighthouse restoration.
West End buoy had one CTD about two feet below the surface and another on the seafloor/bottom below the buoy. It is currently down for annual maintenance, so it is not admitted as current.
No defensible station-specific height-above-bottom statement was found in the reviewed online sources.

primary_sources.station: WKQA1 Fish River, Weeks Bay Reserve
primary_sources.access: NDBC realtime2 ocean feed; existing canonical collector
primary_sources.cadence: NERRS monitoring data nominally updated every 10 minutes
primary_sources.model_role: regional Weeks Bay/Fish River proxy, not Point Clear/Montrose bottom water

secondary_or_rejected.source: IOOS/GCOOS ERDDAP mirror of DISL stations
secondary_or_rejected.reason: Useful for metadata/QARTOD cross-checks but Meaher mirror was stale relative to live ARCOS during this audit; do not make it the primary freshness source.
Useful transport/model context, not a DO sensor observation.
Useful calibration/antecedent evidence but not regular real-time Mobile Bay DO for this ingest layer.
High-value dual-depth hydrographic station when operational; DISL says annual maintenance is underway and NDBC reports no recent data. Retain as monitored future source, not current evidence.

meaher_dawn_corroboration.independent_live_series_check: The public ARCOS two-day series returned matching 0.23 mg/L and 3.10% values in the recent sequence, corroborating the report as source data rather than a social-only observation.
meaher_dawn_corroboration.production_interpretation: Strong upper-bay oxygen-loading observation; not direct Point Clear shoreline bottom DO and not automatically a Jubilee label.

implementation.polling: twice hourly at minute 05 and 35 during canonical May 18-November 14 season
implementation.current_state: Fresh range-screened hydrographic and meteorological ARCOS station observations are admitted as zero-weight context; stale values become UNKNOWN_STALE. Historical sensor-height metadata are carried as provenance only and do not create current bottom identity.
